title: Member Handbook, Article 12: The Life of a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
**12.1 Application.** An application for an account of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts goes to the credit department, comes back approved with a limit or declined outright, and only an approved account ever buys on terms.

**12.2 Decline.** A declined application closes without ever having been active, and the member buys for cash; a fresh application may be made once the ground for the decline has changed, which is a credit matter and not a counter one.

**12.3 Closure by the member.** A member closes an account of their own accord only with nothing owing, no prepay standing unapplied and no product out on the field awaiting invoice, and the closure is theirs to make rather than the desk's.

**12.4 Prepay standing unapplied.** Where prepay stands unapplied the account cannot close until the prepay is drawn, transferred where the programme allows it, or forfeited at the end of its forfeiture period.

**12.5 Closure by the cooperative.** The cooperative closes a suspended account of its own motion by writing the balance over to the credit department, and that closure does not extinguish what is owed; the balance follows the member and is recovered from grain settlements and patronage as they arise.

**12.6 Terminal.** A closed account is terminal and is never reopened, so a member coming back needs a fresh application and a fresh review.

## The three conditions of a member's own closure

A member's own closure of a Crop Input Purchasing Account requires all three of: nothing owing on the account; no prepay standing unapplied; and no product out on the field awaiting invoice. Any one of them unmet and the account does not close on the member's motion.

| Owing | Unapplied prepay | Product awaiting invoice | The member's own closure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| none | none | none | Available to the member |
| standing | none | none | Not available |
| none | standing | none | Not available until the prepay is drawn, transferred where the programme allows it, or forfeited |
| none | none | out on the field | Not available |
